why: The finding survives all three checks, but two of its sub-claims are wrong and must not travel with it. (1) QUOTE: verbatim at whats-new/2026-w16.md:125, a single-clause <div> in the 'Other wins' grid with nothing after it that reverses the conclusion. It is not an isolated release note either: hooks.md:730 carries the row '| `PreCompact` | Yes | Blocks compaction |' in the exit-code-2 table; hooks.md:865 and :890 list PreCompact among the nine top-level-`decision` events ('The only value is "block"'); and hooks.md:2613 states 'Exit with code 2 to block compaction. For a manual `/compact`, the stderr message is shown to the user. You can also block by returning JSON with "decision": "block".' hooks.md:2615 even specifies what a blocked auto-compact does. whats-new/2026-w16 is row 178 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv, so it is a Claude contract page. (2) CITED LINES: all accurate. types.ts:83 is `{ version: 1, event: 'PreCompact', owner: 'lifecycle-bridge', kind: 'observational', ... }`; hook-decision-contract.ts:49 has 'PreCompact' as the ninth entry of TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS; lifecycle-bridge.ts:150-153 is the sole emitter (`pi.on('session_before_compact', ...)` -> `await options.emit('PreCompact', ...)`) and :28 declares `emit(event, input): Promise<void> | void`. (3) CONSEQUENCE, verified separately from the identifiers and confirmed on the default Pi runtime: the two host-side sites that act on a block are `runPiPromptGate` (pi-agent.ts:6430), which is gated by `hookBlockEndsTurn(event)` — false for PreCompact, since ALWAYS_TERMINAL_BLOCK_EVENTS is only UserPromptSubmit/UserPromptExpansion/PostToolBatch — and only iterates PI_PROMPT_GATE_EVENTS; and `toTaskEventDecision` (SessionManager.ts:2195), which serves TaskCreated/TaskCompleted only. There is no compaction consumer anywhere: the projected `block`/`reason` from projectHookDecisionForEvent is produced and dropped, and the emit is fire-and-forget through createPiLifecycleSinkGate (lifecycle-bridge.ts:37-48), so compaction proceeds. CORRECTION A — the claim's 'the two halves of our own contract disagree' is a misreading and should be struck. `kind` in AGENT_EVENT_CONTRACTS_V1 is a permission-receipt axis, defined at lifecycle-bridge.ts:19-21: '`kind`: `decision` for the frozen decision-bearing hooks (PreToolUse receipt/epoch and PermissionRequest); every other hook is `observational` and can never block or bypass a permission receipt.' PostToolUse, Stop, SubagentStop and ConfigChange are ALL `kind: 'observational'` and ALL in TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS, and TaskCreated/TaskCompleted are `kind: 'decision'` yet deliberately NOT in it (they are exit-code-only). The two tables are orthogonal axes, so there is no internal contradiction — only one missing consumer. CORRECTION B — the finding missed the internal staleness that IS real: hook-decision-contract.ts:236 asserts '`ConfigChange`/`PreCompact` are advisory', which hooks.md now contradicts for BOTH events (:719 'ConfigChange | Yes | Blocks the configuration change from taking effect (except `policy_settings`)' and :730 for PreCompact). CORRECTION C — Pi is not the blocker the R9 plan assumed. pi-agent-core/dist/harness/agent-harness.js `compact()` awaits `emitHook({ type: 'session_before_compact', preparation, branchEntries, customInstructions, signal })` and then `if (hookResult?.cancel) throw new AgentHarnessError('compaction', 'Compaction cancelled')`; `SessionBeforeCompactResult` is `{ cancel?: boolean; compaction?: CompactResult }` (harness/types.d.ts:488-491) and emitHook keeps the last defined handler return. Our handler simply returns nothing, exactly as the `tool_result` handler two blocks above DOES return a value Pi consumes. So the veto primitive exists in-process; the missing piece is an awaited host round trip that maps a block to `{ cancel: true }`, not a new Pi capability. SCOPE CAVEAT — the consequence is false on the Claude backend: automationResultToSdkHookResult (hooks-automation.ts:1673-1681) maps ANY blocking decision, PreCompact included, to `{ continue: false, decision: 'block', reason }` for the Claude Agent SDK, which enforces compaction blocking itself. That backend is off by default (NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE), so the gap is Pi-specific. NOT REFUTED BY A RECORDED DECISION: PreCompact is not among the nine dated owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries), and it is not a rebrand or a dropped-subscription-flow difference. It IS already logged as an R9 deviation (2026-07-29-deviation-audit.md:140 'Parsed then discarded on Pi (one-way ...)'; 2026-07-27-hook-decision-patterns.md:113, :257, :410) — the deviation register is the index of real divergences, so that corroborates the finding rather than refuting it.
correctedState: On the Pi runtime (the default and the only backend enabled by default), a PreCompact hook cannot stop a compaction. The hook runs and its output is parsed: PreCompact is one of the nine TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS (hook-decision-contract.ts:49), so projectHookDecisionForEvent lets `block`/`deny` + `reason` through. Nothing consumes it — the only emitter is lifecycle-bridge.ts:150-153, whose `options.emit` is the fire-and-forget `Promise<void> | void` sink (:28, gate at :37-48), and the two host-side block consumers cover only UserPromptSubmit/UserPromptExpansion (pi-agent.ts:6430, via `hookBlockEndsTurn`, false for PreCompact) and TaskCreated/TaskCompleted (SessionManager.ts:2195). Exit code 2 is likewise inert here. Three qualifications the original claim got wrong or missed: (a) there is NO contradiction between `kind: 'observational'` (types.ts:83) and TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS — `kind` is the permission-receipt axis (lifecycle-bridge.ts:19-21) and PostToolUse/Stop/SubagentStop/ConfigChange share the same combination; (b) the real stale line is hook-decision-contract.ts:236, which still calls `ConfigChange`/`PreCompact` 'advisory' although hooks.md:719 and :730 now give both a real block; (c) Pi already exposes the veto — agent-harness.js `compact()` cancels on a `session_before_compact` handler returning `{ cancel: true }` (SessionBeforeCompactResult, harness/types.d.ts:488-491) — so closing this needs an awaited host round trip returning `cancel`, not a new Pi mechanism. On the Claude backend (off by default, NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE) the block IS honoured: automationResultToSdkHookResult (hooks-automation.ts:1673-1681) forwards it to the SDK as `{ continue: false, decision: 'block' }`.
